name: Svetlana Romanova
source: Svetlana was born and raised in eastern Europe. Her mother is a famous witch doctor, and Svetlana learned a lot from her. During one of his trips to Europe, Arthur discovered her rare talent for healing magic and invited the girl to study at Cordale. After graduating, she decided to stay in the Academy and accepted her position as Academy's nurse.
